coherence.note: positive drift = the student assigns LOWER probability to the base model's own fluent continuation, i.e. it has moved away from the base's general behaviour. Read alongside the neutral fraction of the training mix.
coherence.correction: CORRECTED AFTER THE RUN. n was reported as 50, but COHERENCE_CORPUS at the time was ten prompts repeated five times, and generation runs at temperature 0, so the fifty measurements were ten distinct values each counted five times. The mean and median drift are unaffected - repeating identical values does not move them - but the effective sample size is 10, and any variance or interval computed on n=50 would be wrong by a factor of sqrt(5). The corpus now contains fifty distinct prompts (harness/scenarios.py, commit 9b756ef); this artifact predates that fix and is left otherwise unmodified as the record of what the run produced. See results/CORRECTIONS.md.
